We begin in the name of Allah. He is full of mercy to everyone in this world, and He has special mercy for the believers.
All thanks and praise belong to Allah alone. He is the Lord who created and takes care of everything in all the worlds.
We remember again that Allah is full of mercy and kindness.
Allah is the King of the Day of Judgment, the day when everyone will get what they earned.
We worship only You, Allah, and we ask only You for help.
We ask Allah to show us the straight path, which is the right way to live.
The straight path is the way of the people Allah blessed, like the prophets and the good people. It is not the way of those who made Allah angry, and not the way of those who lost their way.
